title: Constraint language — Retrieval-by-Constraint (Signature)
description:

Retrieval-by-constraint treats a search as a satisfaction problem: the caller states several simultaneous requirements — date ranges, numeric bounds, categorical memberships, full-text conditions — and the system returns only records that satisfy all of them. demo:
# Retrieval-by-Constraint demo: selectivity-ordered predicate planning.
RECS=[{"id":"p1","year":2019,"pages":120,"open":True,"topic":"sails"},
      {"id":"p2","year":2022,"pages":45,"open":False,"topic":"sails"},
      {"id":"p3","year":2023,"pages":200,"open":True,"topic":"rockets"},
      {"id":"p4","year":2021,"pages":90,"open":True,"topic":"sails"}]
CONSTRAINTS=[("year",">=",2020,0.5),("open","==",True,0.4),("pages","<",150,0.6),("topic","==","sails",0.7)]
def ev(rec,f,op,v):
    return {"==":rec[f]==v,">=":rec[f]>=v,"<":rec[f]<v}[op]
ordered=sorted(CONSTRAINTS,key=lambda c:c[3])
hits=[r for r in RECS if all(ev(r,f,op,v) for f,op,v,_ in ordered)]
print("plan order:",[c[0] for c in ordered])
print("hits:",[r["id"] for r in hits])

# Retrieval-by-Constraint demo: selectivity-ordered predicate planning.
RECS=[{"id":"p1","year":2019,"pages":120,"open":True,"topic":"sails"},
      {"id":"p2","year":2022,"pages":45,"open":False,"topic":"sails"},
      {"id":"p3","year":2023,"pages":200,"open":True,"topic":"rockets"},
      {"id":"p4","year":2021,"pages":90,"open":True,"topic":"sails"}]
CONSTRAINTS=[("year",">=",2020,0.5),("open","==",True,0.4),("pages","<",150,0.6),("topic","==","sails",0.7)]
def ev(rec,f,op,v):
    return {"==":rec[f]==v,">=":rec[f]>=v,"<":rec[f]<v}[op]
ordered=sorted(CONSTRAINTS,key=lambda c:c[3])
hits=[r for r in RECS if all(ev(r,f,op,v) for f,op,v,_ in ordered)]
print("plan order:",[c[0] for c in ordered])
print("hits:",[r["id"] for r in hits])

description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. Retrieval-by-constraint treats a search as a satisfaction problem: the caller states several simultaneous requirements — date ranges, numeric bounds, categorical memberships, full-text conditions — and the system returns only records that satisfy all of them. It is the workhorse behind faceted search, compliance queries, and engineering part selection. The machinery is a constraint planner that orders predicates by selectivity and a clear language for expressing them.

This record documents the saved constraint sets approach: Persist named constraint bundles with versioning so compliance queries reproduce exactly.
